look_here_first: Small annual milkvetch with pink-purple flowers and very narrow straight pods that split lengthwise when mature.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local source; Kew accepts the species as native in Texas.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; exact target-zone county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Fabaceae/Astragalus: alternate pinnate leaves, papilionoid pea flowers, and legumes; fruit shape, inflation, hairiness, and curvature are especially useful for species ID.
best_field_traits: small pink to purple pea flowers
fruit proportionally much longer than wide
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Think narrowest fruit in the batch. It lacks the thick groundplum pod and differs from Nuttall's milkvetch by its especially slim straight legumes.
